hints.tr: `raw.split("\n")` satırları verir; başlıklar `lines[1:]`. Her satırda `name, value = line.split(": ", 1)`.
hints.en: `raw.split("\n")` gives the lines; the headers are `lines[1:]`. On each line: `name, value = line.split(": ", 1)`.

hints.tr: Saklarken `headers[name.lower()] = value`. Var mı yok mu sorusu için `"authorization" in headers`.
hints.en: Store with `headers[name.lower()] = value`. To ask whether it is there: `"authorization" in headers`.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
raw = """GET /v1/books HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8000
ACCEPT: application/json
user-agent: odyssey-client/1.0"""

lines = raw.split("\n")
headers = {}
for line in lines[1:]:
    name, value = line.split(": ", 1)
    headers[name.lower()] = value

print("host:", headers["host"])
print("accept:", headers["accept"])
print("has authorization:", "authorization" in headers)
```
hints.en:
The solution:

```python
raw = """GET /v1/books HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8000
ACCEPT: application/json
user-agent: odyssey-client/1.0"""

lines = raw.split("\n")
headers = {}
for line in lines[1:]:
    name, value = line.split(": ", 1)
    headers[name.lower()] = value

print("host:", headers["host"])
print("accept:", headers["accept"])
print("has authorization:", "authorization" in headers)
```
